import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel("DanhSachHoaDon.xlsx", sheet_name="Sheet1", usecols="A:K")
print("cols:", list(df.columns))
print("shape:", df.shape)

# Convert date column 'Thời gian' (col B) - mixed numeric (excel serial) and string
d = df["Thời gian"].copy()
def to_date(v):
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        # excel serial date
        return pd.Timestamp(pd.to_datetime(v, unit="D", origin=pd.Timestamp(1899,12,31)))
    s = str(v).strip()
    if not s:
        return pd.NaT
    for fmt in ("%d/%m/%Y", "%Y-%m-%d"):
        try:
            return pd.to_datetime(s, format=fmt)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return pd.to_datetime(s, errors="coerce")

df["d"] = d.map(to_date)
print(df["d"].dtype)
print(df["d"].min(), df["d"].max())

# November 2025
nov = df[(df["d"].dt.year==2025) & (df["d"].dt.month==11)]
print("nov rows (raw):", len(nov))

# Exclude summary rows (content starting with 'Tổng')
nov = nov[~nov["Ghi chú"].astype(str).str.startswith("Tổng", na=False)]
# also check 'Ghi chú' not the right col; summary rows likely have empty Ghi chú. Check 'Khách hàng' or others.
print("after summary filter:", len(nov))

# Status counts
print(nov["Trạng thái"].value_counts(dropna=False))

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel("DanhSachHoaDon.xlsx", sheet_name="Sheet1", usecols="A:L")
df["d"] = df["Thời gian"].map(lambda v: pd.Timestamp(pd.to_datetime(v, unit="D", origin=pd.Timestamp(1899,12,31))) if isinstance(v,(int,float)) else pd.to_datetime(str(v), errors="coerce"))

nov = df[(df["d"].dt.year==2025) & (df["d"].dt.month==11)].copy()
print("nov total rows:", len(nov))
print("status counts:", nov["Trạng thái"].value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict())

# Exclude cancelled & returned (keep 'xong' only; 'đang giao' would also count but none here)
kept = nov[nov["Trạng thái"].isin(["xong"])]
print("kept (xong) rows:", len(kept))

# Exclude khách lẻ (null Mã KH)
kept = kept[kept["Mã KH"].notna()]
print("kept with Mã KH:", len(kept))

cnt = kept.groupby("Mã KH").size().sort_values(ascending=False)
top = cnt.head(10)
print(top.to_string())

# Show the top customer's name
top_kh = top.index[0]
name = kept[kept["Mã KH"]==top_kh]["Khách hàng"].iloc[0]
print("TOP:", top_kh, "->", name)
